Liam Gilchrist is the CEO and co-founder of Lexical Labs, a legal-tech company building AI systems to read and reason over complex contracts. Based in Australia and leading a global team, he works at the intersection of large-language-model research, product strategy, and legal workflow design. Liam writes about the practical realities of deploying LLMs, transforming legal work, and building AI-driven products from the ground up.
